copy.h1: He won $121 million in prize money and made a billion anyway. We followed the money.
copy.lede: Who’s who, what he owns, what the sponsors paid, what’s on the court record, and the money on the public record. Every number links to its source.
copy.familyLede: Tap anyone to open their file. Tiger and Elin’s two children appear by first name only.
copy.investLede: His businesses are private. Nike, his sponsor for 27 years, trades on the NYSE, but that deal ended in 2024.
copy.moneyLede: Two decades of sponsor checks and prize money, now spread across golf businesses and real estate. Only Tiger has a published net worth.
copy.recordLede: What tour records, sponsor deals and a Florida court show. Filings and reporting, not guesses.
copy.trailLede: From a golf-mad Army dad in California to a billion dollars.

summary.t: A retired U.S. Army officer and Vietnam War veteran. In 1996 the two started what is now the TGR Foundation to bring golf to inner-city children. He died on May 3, 2006.
Known as Tida. She died on Feb. 4, 2025.
Won 15 majors and a record-tying 82 PGA Tour events. Forbes counted him a billionaire in 2022, the second active athlete to get there after LeBron James.

owns.t: Cofounded it with Rory McIlroy in 2022; it launched the TGL league in 2025.
Investor in the upscale mini-golf chain.
Founded his golf course design firm in 2006.
His apparel line, launched with TaylorMade in 2024.

record.t: Forbes estimates he has earned nearly $2 billion before taxes, including a PGA Tour-record $121 million in prize money. Most of the rest came from sponsors; Nike alone paid him more than $500 million over 27 years.
He turned down a reported offer from the Saudi-backed LIV Golf league. Its then-CEO, Greg Norman, said it was in the “high nine digits.”
In 2024 the PGA Tour started handing players equity to reward loyalty. The Telegraph reported Woods would get $100 million; the AP could not confirm the figure.

On March 27, 2026, he rolled his car near his Jupiter Island home after clipping another vehicle; no one was hurt. He was arrested on suspicion of DUI. In September he pleaded no contest to reckless driving and refusing a test, was fined $1,500 plus costs, and lost his license for five years.

facts.t: He bought a $39 million estate on Jupiter Island, Florida, in 2006 and built a home there.
He is a partner in Nexxus, a luxury real estate venture, with Justin Timberlake and Joe Lewis.

kidsNote.t: Tiger and Elin have two children, Sam and Charlie. We list first names only.

summary.t: They had reportedly been dating since late 2024, and Tiger confirmed the relationship in March 2025. She was married to Donald Trump Jr., with whom she has five children.
They married on Oct. 5, 2004, and divorced in 2010.
